description: Documentation and CLI tooling (Wave 5): Create comprehensive documentation covering architecture, agent responsibilities, safety constraints, and troubleshooting. Provide example CLI script demonstrating workflow execution.
steps: Create docs/migration-repair-workflow.md with sections: Architecture overview with DAG diagram, Agent responsibilities (all 13 agents), Safety constraints (production database protection), Evidence requirements and ledger format, How to add new verification stages, How to extend ALLOWED_COMMANDS, Troubleshooting guide for common failures

Create scripts/run-migration-repair.py CLI script that: creates workflow_id, initializes AgentCoordinator, executes agents in DAG order via execute_dag(), logs progress to stdout, writes final report to .agents/tasks/migration-repair-{workflow_id}-report.json
Add --dry-run flag to CLI script for execution plan preview without mutations
Add usage examples to docs showing: basic workflow execution, custom database URL, enabling verbose logging, interpreting evidence ledger
Update services/project-ai/README.md to reference migration repair workflow documentation
